# imagines

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:imagines`](gmeow-imagines.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/imagines>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/imagination`](../../slices/imagination.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent entertains content AS-IF — quasi-perceptually, decoupled from current perception and from belief: picturing a scene, an object, or a situation without holding it true. The base imaginative attitude and the cheap 80% surface. Range is intentionally OPEN: the object may be a [`gmeow:Proposition`](../classes/gmeow-Proposition.md), a described scene, or any content (the five-minute-gate shortcut, [Principle 13](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-13)). Non-functional — an agent imagines many things at once. The corresponding occurrent is a [`gmeow:MentalProcess`](../classes/gmeow-MentalProcess.md) with [`gmeow:mentalProcessType`](gmeow-mentalProcessType.md) [`gmeow:processImagining`](../individuals/gmeow-processImagining.md) (mentation, by reference); from whose vantage the content is entertained rides [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the statement, never a truth bit here.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record that an agent entertains content quasi-perceptually as-if — picturing a scene or situation without holding it true — the base imaginative attitude and the natural companion of a [`gmeow:processImagining`](../individuals/gmeow-processImagining.md) episode; reach for it for counterfactual rehearsal, planning rollouts, and fiction.

### Avoid when

- Avoid where the agent HOLDS the content true (use [`gmeow:believes`](gmeow-believes.md)) or takes it on pragmatically for argument (use [`gmeow:accepts`](gmeow-accepts.md)) or merely hypothesises a proposition (use [`gmeow:supposes`](gmeow-supposes.md)); imagining asserts neither truth nor commitment, and it is never a factive verdict about the content.

### How to use

- Point the agent at the content it entertains; tag the content's reality-monitoring source with [`gmeow:contentOrigin`](gmeow-contentOrigin.md) [`gmeow:originImagined`](../individuals/gmeow-originImagined.md), link the explored world with [`gmeow:imaginedWorld`](gmeow-imaginedWorld.md) ([logic:World](https://blackcatinformatics.ca/logic/World), by reference) when a counterfactual world is in play, and carry the vantage on [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) of the statement rather than asserting the content as a fact.

### Scope notes

- Distinct from belief and acceptance (no axiom): [`gmeow:believes`](gmeow-believes.md) holds content TRUE (mind-to-world fit) and [`gmeow:accepts`](gmeow-accepts.md) takes it on PRAGMATICALLY for argument; [`gmeow:imagines`](gmeow-imagines.md) entertains it AS-IF, asserting neither truth nor pragmatic commitment. The imagined content's source is marked with [`gmeow:contentOrigin`](gmeow-contentOrigin.md) [`gmeow:originImagined`](../individuals/gmeow-originImagined.md) for reality-monitoring, never an isReal flag.

### Examples

- ex:lillith [`gmeow:imagines`](gmeow-imagines.md) ex:dragonOnTheLawn.
